finalSelectionChecklist: Read and preserve reference example roles and explanation order before choosing replacements.
Verify selected source format AND decoded dimensions are at least 1920x1080; recording claims alone do not pass.
Actually view each selected before/action/result and record exact source time, current version limits, no repeats or slowdowns.
Separate menu/static screenshot explanation time from useful moving action; no filler to satisfy 60:40.
Confirm recorder reuse separately from publisher game-IP conditions; record unresolved rights honestly.
Retain source/game/player credits, protect game UI and fixed captions, and plan readable narration-timed annotations.
Count Nintendo distinct game examples after actual selection; Switch platform alone is not Nintendo authorship.
Compare genre, camera, central action and actual duration against D19/D20, not just game-title novelty.
humanRightsClearance: No separate human-clearance gate created by this research. Root records the selected source-specific use basis and remaining uncertainties transparently.
